```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(scales)
library(ggthemes)
```

```{r}
energy <- read_csv(
  "data/data_raw/owid_energy.csv", show_col_types = FALSE
)

co2 <- read_csv(
  "data/data_raw/owid_co2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE
)


```

```{r}
energy_sel <- energy |>
  select(
    country, iso_code, year,
    renewables_share_elec,
    low_carbon_share_elec,
    fossil_share_elec,
    renewables_electricity,  # TWh
    fossil_electricity       # TWh
  )

co2_sel <- co2 |>
  select(
    country, iso_code, year,
    co2,                     # total CO2 emissions (Mt)
    co2_per_capita,
    consumption_co2_per_capita,
    gdp,
    population
  )

cr_energy_co2 <- energy_sel |>
  left_join(co2_sel,
            by = c("country", "iso_code", "year")) |>
  filter(country == "Costa Rica",
         year >= 1990, year <= 2023)

```

```{r}
# Get 2010 baseline (if missing, pick nearest year you actually have)
cr_base_2010 <- cr_energy_co2 |>
  filter(year == 2010) |>
  pull(co2_per_capita) |>
  first()

cr_pathway <- cr_energy_co2 |>
  mutate(
    co2pc_target_15c = case_when(
      year < 2010 ~ NA_real_,
      year >= 2010 & year <= 2050 ~
        cr_base_2010 * pmax(0, 1 - (year - 2010) / (2050 - 2010)),
      year > 2050 ~ 0
    )
  )

```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=10}

# Trim years to keep only what matters visually
cr_trim <- cr_pathway |>
  filter(year >= 2000)

max_y <- max(cr_trim$co2_per_capita, na.rm = TRUE)

p1 <- ggplot(cr_trim, aes(x = year)) +
  
  # Light shaded window only for evaluation period
  annotate(
  "rect", xmin = 2010, xmax = 2023,
  ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
  fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.5
) +
  
  # 1.5°C pathway
  geom_line(
    aes(y = co2pc_target_15c),
    colour = "#D55E00",
    linewidth = 1.1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # Observed CO2 per capita
  geom_line(
    aes(y = co2_per_capita),
    colour = "#1A1A1A",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  
  # Annotation
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2015, y = max_y * 0.65,
    label = "2023 gap: +0.55 t/person\n(~50% above pathway)",
    hjust = 0, size = 4,
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2010, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
annotate(
  "text", x = 2010, y = 0.15,
  label = "2010 baseline",
  angle = 90, vjust = -0.3, hjust = 0,
  size = 3, colour = "grey40"
)+

  labs(
    title = expression(
    "Costa Rica's " * CO[2] * " per capita vs a 1.5" * degree * "C-compatible pathway"),
    subtitle = "Electricity is already low-carbon; reductions now depend on transport and other fossil uses",
    x = "Year",
    y = expression("CO"[2] * " emissions per capita (tonnes/person)"),
    caption = expression("Source: OWID " * CO[2] * " and Energy datasets.")
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max_y * 1.05)) +
  
  theme_clean(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "#555555")
  )

p1

```
